profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer and an advanced Mandarin Chinese speaker, and I am proud to be supporting and helping defend the American Warfighter.

company.name: UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY

positions.locationName: Newport, Rhode Island, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer + Junior Robotics Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Used only Mandarin Chinese to problem solve, innovate, and to communicate complex technical topics and concepts with team members and mentors, and conducted technical presentations directly to the CEO.

- Engineered the mechanics and circuitry, and developed the software for a fully functional remote-controlled robot, which could relay field-of-view video to the user, emit sound based on distance to objects (using laser range finder), and send distance feedback to the user when requested.

- Helped develop software for encoding/decoding hexadecimal messages through a Raspberry Pi to USB-connected laser range finder and GPIO-connected sound emitter, and combined functionality for real world application.

- Developed algorithm for motor movement, allowing car to be controlled with extreme precision and flexibility
positions.insights: Skills: Product Design · Research and Development (R&D) · Engineering · Programming
